id.description: Package ID: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Defaults to the name of the package directory; when written it must equal that name. `framework` is reserved.

kind.description: Package kind. `core` marks a core plugin, which every session requests by default. Defaults to `plugin`.

version.description: Package version. Setup runtimes rerun for existing sessions when it changes. A package without a version counts as `0.0.0`.

covel.description: Host version range this package supports. A host outside it does not install or load the package.

displayName.description: Player-facing name. Plain string; translations go in locale files.

description.description: What the package does. Plain string; translations go in locale files.

tags.description: Catalogue tags the loader cannot work out, such as `mode:dialogue` or `data:characters`. The loader adds the `ui:*` and `cost:*` tags from the package's panels and runtimes and ignores written ones. `role:` tags are rejected; use contracts.

name.description: Name of the person or team. Shown as written in every language.

about.description: A short message from the author to players: who they are, what else they make, how to support them. Plain text.

url.description: Address of the link. `https` only. The player sees the full address and confirms before it opens.

links.description: Links the author wants players to see, such as a community, a support page or other work. At most 6.

author.description: Who made the package. Shown on the package's cards before play, never during play.

license.description: License of the package: an SPDX identifier or a short name.

homepage.description: Page of the package itself, such as its repository or documentation. `https` only.

default.description: `true` marks the default provider. It steps aside when another provider of the contract is selected.

provides.description: Versioned contracts this package provides that no runtime of it outputs, such as an extension or data contract. The contract of each runtime's `io.output.contract` is added by the loader; write it here only to mark the default provider.

requires.description: Contracts that must have an active provider. The resolver adds one when the package is active. A contract a runtime reads and that is not listed here is optional: the runtime uses it when a provider is active.

conflicts.description: Contracts whose other providers cannot be active together with this package. Plugin contracts only.

schema.description: Package-relative path of the contract's JSON Schema.

contracts.description: Public schema of each contract this package publishes or accepts, keyed by contract ID. A contract that a `contributes.data` namespace accepts needs no entry here: its schema is the one of that namespace.

entry.description: Package-relative path of the server entry module. It registers tools, actions, services, hooks and extensions. Defaults to `./server/index.js` when that file exists.

origin.description: HTTPS origin the runtime may call, without path, query or credentials.

methods.description: HTTP methods allowed for the origin. Entries must be unique.

http.description: Upper bound of the HTTP origins and methods the runtime may use.

permissions.description: Upper bounds of the package's own code. `http` lists the origins and methods the entry module of a community package may reach through `covel.http`, in addition to those its runtimes declare.

tools.description: Names of tools the entry registers with `registerTool`.

items.description: RPC action name. The covel:, runtime: and event: prefixes are reserved for framework approvals.

actions.description: Names of RPC actions the entry registers with `registerRpc`.

name.description: Command name in lowercase kebab-case, without the leading slash.

aliases.description: Other names that invoke the same command.

description.description: What the command does. Shown to the player.

type.description: Value type of the argument. Defaults to string.

description.description: What the argument means. Shown to the player.

required.description: `true` when the player must supply the argument.

variadic.description: `true` collects all remaining words. Only the last argument can be variadic.

arguments.description: Positional arguments, in order. Names must be unique.

action.description: RPC action the command invokes. It must be listed in `contributes.actions`.

context.description: Host context scopes passed to the action.

commands.description: Player slash commands. Each `action` must be listed in `actions`.

name.description: Kind name, unique in the package and not a base kind. The wire kind is `<pluginId>/<name>`.

roles.description: Seat roles that may submit this kind. Defaults to `[player]`.

text.description: Whether the action carries text: `required`, `optional` (default) or `none`.

actor.description: Whether the action is taken as a character. Defaults to `true`: the seat's current character unless the action names another bound one.

schema.description: Package-relative path of the JSON Schema the action's `fields` must match. Without it the kind takes no fields.

label.description: Name of the kind, for the composer and for the model-facing rendering of the action.

display.description: How the composer shows the kind.

actionKinds.description: Action kinds players may submit besides the base kinds. Pure declaration: the server checks each action against its roles, text rule and fields schema. The wire kind is `<pluginId>/<name>`.

services.description: Contract IDs of services the entry registers with `registerService`.

anyOf.description: `<point>/<id>`: the extension point and the ID of this extension in the package, for an entry that sets nothing else.

id.description: ID of this extension within the package.

order.description: Sort order among providers of the same point. Lower values come first. Defaults to 0.

slot.description: UI slot providers only: the kernel UI slot this entry fills.

watch.description: UI slot providers only: own data namespaces whose changes refresh the slot.

preview.description: UI slot providers only: event topics whose in-turn preview refreshes the slot.

anyOf.description: An extension that sets more than its point and ID, such as the `slot` of a `ui.slot@1` provider.

extensions.description: Extensions the entry provides with `provideExtension`: `<point>/<id>`, or an object for one that sets more, such as a UI slot provider.

anyOf.description: Lifecycle event the entry registers a handler for, in the default `normal` phase.

enforce.description: Phase the hook runs in. Defaults to `normal`.

anyOf.description: A hook in another phase: `{ event, enforce }`.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks the entry registers: an event name, or `{ event, enforce }` for a phase other than `normal`.

wires.description: IDs of provider wires the entry registers.

forms.description: IDs of forms the entry registers.

schema.description: Package-relative path of the JSON Schema that validates the event payload.

description.description: What the event means. Given to runtimes that may emit it.

advertise.description: `true` advertises the event to runtimes that emit events. Defaults to `true`.

events.description: Domain events the package's runtimes may emit with the builtin `emit-event` tool.

key.description: Setting key. Runtimes read it from `ctx.userSettings`.

type.description: Control type. `select` needs `options`; `slot` lets the player pick a model slot.

default.description: Value used when neither the player nor the world sets one.

label.description: Label shown in the settings panel.

description.description: Help text shown with the control.

settings.description: Player-configurable settings. A world can preset them with `pluginSettings`.

schema.description: Package-relative JSON Schema that every record of the dataset must satisfy.

key.description: Top-level record field whose string value is the record's key. Omit when callers choose keys.

ops.description: Operation kinds allowed on this dataset. Defaults to every kind.

datasets.description: Typed plugin-data datasets the package owns; the name is the plugin-data namespace.

schema.description: Package-relative path of the JSON Schema that validates each record.

description.description: What the namespace stores. Read by world authors and tools.

version.description: Schema version of the namespace. Defaults to 1; raise it when the record shape changes.

accepts.description: Data contracts whose world data this namespace accepts.

title.description: Author-facing name of this content. Plain string; translations go in locale files.

summary.description: One player-facing sentence about this content. Shown where a player chooses what a generated world includes. Plain string; translations go in locale files.

hint.description: How to write good records: what to include, limits, and links to other content. Read by authors and by generators.

example.description: Package-relative path of a JSON file with a valid example of the source value. It is validated against the namespace schema.

path.description: Conventional path of the source inside a world package. The path sets how it is read: a `.yaml` or `.yml` file, a `.json` file, or a media directory (a path without an extension) whose index this namespace receives. `<dir>/*.<ext>` names every such file of a directory, each one a source, read in file-name order. It may not name a path the kernel or the package itself owns: `world.yaml`, `WORLD.md`, `data/world.data.yaml`, `data/dimensions.yaml`, `data/lorebook.yaml`, `characters/characters.json`, `media/gallery.json`, `media/portraits.json`, `media/scenes.json` or `media/gallery/`, nor an edition of one.

key.description: Field that gives each record a stable key. Defaults to `id`, and to `filename` for a media directory.

localeArrayKeys.description: Additional stable identity fields for nested object lists in locale overlays, after the source key and id. Translations retain these keys when lists are reordered.

visibility.description: `hidden` for content the player must not see before the plugin reveals it. Defaults to `public`.

lorebook.description: `true` also projects each record into the lorebook (`+lorebook`).

source.description: The world data source an author declares to supply this content.

characterField.description: The content is written inside the world's character records instead of a file of its own: each character may carry one record under this field. The character's `id` keys the record, and the character's `name`, `type`, `description` and `fields` are not repeated in it. Not together with `source`.

path.description: Where the referring values are in each record: field names joined by `.`, with `[]` after a field that holds a list. `**.` before a field name finds that field at any depth below.

to.description: What each value must name. `character-attribute` is the `id` of a top-level attribute of the world's `characterSchema`; `world-dimension` is the ID of a dimension the world declares.

type.description: Value type the named attribute must have. Only with `to: character-attribute`.

within.description: Fields beside the referring value that must lie inside what it names. For `character-attribute`, number fields inside the attribute's `min` and `max`; for `world-dimension`, a path into the dimension's value (`a.b`, or a list of keys) that its schema allows.

values.description: Sibling paths holding candidate values of a world dimension. Uses the same path syntax as `path`; `in[]` checks each list member, while `equals` checks the whole value. Checked against the schema at the single `within` path, or the root when absent. Only with `to: world-dimension`; at most one `within` field when set.

references.description: Values in each record that name something of the world. `pnpm validate:world` reports a value that names nothing, or the wrong kind of thing, before a session starts.

generate.description: Lets the in-app world generator produce this content from `hint` and `example` alone. `offer` lists it as a choice; `default` also selects it. It needs an `example`, and a `characterField` or a public, non-media `source` keyed by `id`.

authoring.description: What a world author needs to supply this content. Authoring tools and the world generator read it.

text.description: Field of a record's value that holds the text to search. A record without a string there is not searched.

search.description: Makes the records of this namespace part of memory search (`memory-search`) while the plugin is active in the session.

data.description: Own plugin data namespaces, keyed by namespace.

view.description: Paths of UI specs for full-column views the player can switch to.

right.description: Paths of UI specs for right-panel tabs.

message.description: Paths of UI specs rendered inside the message stream.

segment.description: Paths of display-only templates for committed story paragraphs, matched by segment kind or speaker.

ui.description: Package-relative paths of declarative UI specs, by placement.

from.description: Schema URI of the world data source to project. Only sources with exactly this schema are projected.

handler.description: Package-relative path of the pure projection handler module.

namespace.description: Own data namespace that receives the projected records.

key.description: Field of each projected record used as its stable key.

outputs.description: Destinations keyed by output ID. At least one is required.

worldProjections.description: Pure projections from world data into own namespaces, keyed by projection ID.

id.description: ID of the segment within the package.

depth.description: Message depth at which the segment is inserted.

position.description: Where the segment goes: `system`, `pre-history`, `post-history`, or `{ depth }` for a position relative to the message history.

role.description: Message role of the segment. Defaults to `system`.

prompt.description: Static prompt segments. The host registers them.

contributes.description: Package-level contributions. Every entry registration needs a declaration here, and every declaration needs an implementation.

description.description: What the runtime does. Plain string; translations go in locale files.

stage.description: Stage the runtime runs in. Required for an `auto` trigger, the default. Order: `setup`, `pre-turn`, `narrative`, `post-turn`, `audit`.

every.description: `auto` only: run on the logical turns that are a multiple of this number. Defaults to 1, every turn.

type.description: `auto` runs in its stage every turn, or every `schedule.every`-th turn. `manual` runs on an explicit RPC call. `event` runs when `topic` is emitted. Defaults to `auto`.

topic.description: Event topic to subscribe to. Required for `event`.

maxTriggerCount.description: Maximum number of triggers in one session.

cooldownTurns.description: Minimum number of turns between two triggers.

startTurn.description: First logical turn at which the runtime may trigger. When unset, it triggers as soon as its stage opens.

trigger.description: When the runtime is activated. Leave it out for an `auto` runtime without options.

runtime.description: Runtime ID in this package: `<pluginId>/<runtimeId>`, or the package ID for a single runtime.

scope.description: `turn` gates on the same execution. `session` gates on the persistent setup snapshot and is valid only on stage `setup`.

contract.description: Contract ID. List it in the package's `requires` when a provider must be active; otherwise the runtime uses it when one is.

cardinality.description: `one` takes a single provider; `all` takes every provider. Defaults to `one`.

scope.description: `turn` gates on the same execution. `session` gates on the persistent setup snapshot and is valid only on stage `setup`.

needs.description: Upstream runtimes or contracts that must succeed first. Sets order and gates this runtime.

runtime.description: Runtime ID in this package: `<pluginId>/<runtimeId>`, or the package ID for a single runtime.

contract.description: Contract ID. This runtime runs after the contract's active providers; it never activates a provider.

cardinality.description: `one` takes a single provider; `all` takes every provider. Defaults to `one`.

after.description: Upstream runtimes or contracts that run first. Sets order only; it does not gate and does not activate a provider.

settle.description: `true` makes the next player action wait until this runtime's job has finished, for at most `maxSettleWaitMs`. Defaults to `false`.

maxSettleWaitMs.description: Longest time in ms the next action waits for the job, at most 120000. Requires `settle: true`.

maxQueueMs.description: Longest time in ms the job may wait in the queue.

maxExecutionMs.description: Longest time in ms the job may run.

detached.description: `true` lets the turn finish before this runtime does: it runs afterwards as a durable background job. Only on stage `post-turn` or `audit`. An object sets the job's options and also makes it detached. Defaults to `false`: the turn waits.

background.description: `true` runs a `manual` or `event` activation as a durable background job: the caller gets a job ID at once. Defaults to `false`: the caller waits for the result.

subagentOnly.description: `true` makes this agent runtime a sub-agent provider: the scheduler never runs it, and another runtime runs it with `ctx.agents.run` or the `delegate` tool. It implies `trigger: manual` and allows no `stage`, `needs`, `after`, `background`, `io.output.recordAs`, `guard` or `io.visibility: story`. Defaults to `false`.

schedule.description: When and in what order the runtime runs.

runtime.description: Runtime ID in this package: `<pluginId>/<runtimeId>`, or the package ID for a single runtime.

contract.description: Contract ID. List it in the package's `requires` when a provider must be active; otherwise the runtime uses it when one is.

cardinality.description: `one` takes a single provider; `all` takes every provider. Defaults to `one`.

kernel.description: Kernel input: the frozen last player input and the runtime results observed so far.

from.description: Producer of the value: a runtime in this package, a contract, or a kernel input. A kernel input takes no other field.

scope.description: `turn` reads the same execution's upstream result. `committed` reads the latest committed export and needs `recordAs`. Defaults to `turn`.

select.description: JSON Pointer applied to the upstream value. Declaring `select` with `scope: committed` is rejected; committed inputs read the complete export.

required.description: `true` stops this runtime when the upstream value is missing or failed. Defaults to `true`. A story runtime (`io.visibility: story`) must set it to `false` for contract inputs.

accepts.description: Schema the bound value must satisfy: a local path or `contract:<contractId>`. It adds to the public contract check.

recordAs.description: Export key to read from the producer. Required with `scope: committed`.

inputs.description: Typed input bindings keyed by local name. An agent reads them at `runtime-inputs.<name>.value`.

namespace.description: Own data namespace to inline. Data of other plugins cannot be read.

as.description: Tag that wraps the injected block in the prompt.

format.description: `summary` lists key, update time and truncated JSON. `ids-only` lists keys. `full` lists complete JSON. Defaults to `summary`.

maxEntries.description: Maximum number of entries injected. Above it, half are the oldest and half the most recently updated. Defaults to 50.

selfData.description: Own plugin data inlined into the agent prompt.

payloadSchema.description: Schema that validates the activation payload.

contract.description: Contract this runtime's output publishes. The package provides it; `provides` needs no entry for it.

schema.description: Private schema that validates the runtime's output.

recordAs.description: Export key under which the output is persisted for later executions. Requires `schema`.

visibility.description: Output kind the kernel dispatches on: `story` for the main narrative provider, `system` for every other runtime. Defaults to `system`.

concealed.description: `true` for a runtime that handles hidden content. Its prompt, model reply, tool arguments, results and output are removed from traces, live streams and API results, and text it returns is not written to the conversation. Not allowed with `visibility: story`.

io.description: What the runtime reads and produces.

model.description: Model slot the agent uses. Defaults to `story` with `io.visibility: story`, otherwise `plugin`.

name.description: Name of the tool to force.

toolChoice.description: `required` makes the model call a tool on every step. `{ name }` makes it call that one tool. Without it, the model chooses.

reasoning.description: `false` turns model reasoning off for this runtime. Defaults to `true`: the model's own reasoning setting applies.

includeSummaries.description: Include persisted summaries alongside the bounded history window. Defaults to false.

maxTurns.description: Number of most recent turns kept in the agent's prompt history. `0` sends no history.

history.description: Bounds the agent's prompt history. When omitted, the runtime sees the shared session history.

builtin.description: Names of builtin tools the runtime may call.

plugin.description: Names of this package's own tools the runtime may call. Each must be listed in `contributes.tools`. The runtime of a single-runtime package gets every contributed tool when this is omitted.

defer.description: Deferred tool loading. `true` defers the whole whitelist; a list defers only those names.

tools.description: Tools the agent's model may call.

advertiseEvents.description: `true` lists the session's event directory in the prompt so the model knows which topics it may emit.

finishWith.description: Tool that ends the run: the run completes after a successful call to it, and fails if it ends without one. The model must call a tool on every step (`toolChoice: required`) unless `toolChoice` says otherwise. Not with `completion`, which is the long form for several tools or explicit completion.

require.description: `explicit` needs a completing tool or `runtime-done`. `tool-use` needs a successful tool named in `afterTools`, or any successful business tool when `afterTools` is empty. Failed calls and `runtime-done` do not count.

afterTools.description: The runtime completes after a successful call to one of these tools.

completion.description: How the agent run ends. For one completing tool, `finishWith` is shorter.

maxSteps.description: Maximum number of tool-call steps. Use 1 or 2 for a runtime that calls one tool and stops.

timeoutMs.description: Time limit of the runtime in ms. The time a streamed model call spends writing does not count. Defaults to 120000; 240000 with `io.visibility: story`.

callTimeoutMs.description: Time limit of one model call that is not streamed, in ms. Defaults to 60000; 120000 with `io.visibility: story`.

firstTokenTimeoutMs.description: Time limit for the first streamed token in ms, the same for every attempt. Without it an attempt waits at most 120000, and no longer than leaves room in `timeoutMs` for the retries still allowed.

idleTimeoutMs.description: Longest silence of a streamed model call that has started to write, in ms. A model that keeps writing is not cut off. Defaults to 120000.

maxRetries.description: Retries on a transient model failure; `0` disables retry. Defaults to 3; 1 with `io.visibility: story`.

loopDetection.description: Number of repeated tool calls that counts as a loop. Defaults to 3; `0` disables detection.

maxRecursionDepth.description: Maximum depth of nested `ctx.recursiveCall()`. Defaults to 10.

profile.description: Loop profile the other loop behaviour keys override. `story` streams to the player, reads interjections and keeps a cut reply; `actor` and `system` do neither, and `actor` answers without tools where `system` fails. Defaults to `story` with `io.visibility: story`, otherwise `system`.

stream.description: Show the model's text to the player as it streams. Needs `io.visibility: story`. Defaults to the profile's value: true for `story`.

steering.description: Merge the player's interjections into the transcript before each step and after a prose finish. Needs `io.visibility: story`. Defaults to the profile's value: true for `story`.

truncation.description: `accept` keeps a reply cut at the output limit; `reject` fails it. `accept` needs streaming. Defaults to `accept` for `story`, otherwise `reject`.

fallback.description: What a repeated tool loop does: `answer-without-tools` takes the tools away and asks for the answer; `fail` stops the runtime. Defaults to `fail` for `system`, otherwise `answer-without-tools`.

toolUse.description: Corrections for missing required tool use or explicit completion. Defaults to 1.

review.description: Corrections after a PostLLMResponse rejection. Defaults to 2.

loopPerturbation.description: Perturbations before the repeated-tool fallback. Defaults to 1.

outputRepair.description: Requests with tools off to repair invalid output. Defaults to 1.

corrections.description: Independent correction budgets for one agent loop run; 0 disables that correction.

maxSteps.description: At the step limit, ask once for the answer with tools off. `false` makes the step limit always fail. Defaults to true.

deadlineReserveMs.description: Stop starting steps this many ms before the time limit and ask for the answer with tools off, when prose can complete the runtime. At most half of `timeoutMs` is used; smaller than `timeoutMs`. Defaults to 0, off.

finalizer.description: The final answer step, with tools off.

loop.description: Time, retry and step limits of the agent loop, and its profile.

agent.description: Settings of an agent runtime, the kind of a runtime without a `function` block: it drives model tool calls from the prompt body.

handler.description: Path of the handler module, relative to this manifest. The module default-exports the handler function. Defaults to `./handler.js` next to the manifest when that file exists.

model.description: Model slot the handler's gateway calls route through. Declared so a detached job's credential readiness check judges the same slot the call resolves.

timeoutMs.description: Time limit of the handler in ms.

builtin.description: Names of builtin tools the runtime may call.

plugin.description: Names of this package's own tools the runtime may call. Each must be listed in `contributes.tools`. The runtime of a single-runtime package gets every contributed tool when this is omitted.

defer.description: Deferred tool loading. `true` defers the whole whitelist; a list defers only those names.

tools.description: Tools the handler may call through `ctx.tools.call`.

function.description: Makes this a function runtime, which runs a JavaScript handler instead of a model. `function: {}` takes every default. Not allowed with `agent`.

guard.description: Path of the guard module. It runs before the runtime and can skip it.

reads.description: Resources the runtime reads, such as `narrative:*` or `plugin-data:self:<namespace>`. Entries must be unique.

writes.description: Resources the runtime writes, such as `state:*` or `event:<topic>`. Entries must be unique.

parallelSafe.description: `true` states that the runtime is safe to run in parallel with its stage siblings.

effects.description: Declared read and write sets, used to detect parallel hazards.

origin.description: HTTPS origin the runtime may call, without path, query or credentials.

methods.description: HTTP methods allowed for the origin. Entries must be unique.

http.description: Upper bound of the HTTP origins and methods the runtime may use.

runtime.description: The single inline runtime of this package; its prompt is the body of this file. Packages with several runtimes use `runtimes/<id>/RUNTIME.md` instead.
